promotion_gates.title: AgentCard schema validated
promotion_gates.description: A2AAgentCard model validates against rig.relay.a2a.agent_card.v1 schema with local_only=true and remote_federation_supported=false.

promotion_gates.title: TaskCard schema validated
promotion_gates.description: A2ATaskCard model validates against rig.relay.a2a.task_card.v1 schema. Status enum covers all 7 lifecycle states.

promotion_gates.title: TaskLifecycleEvent schema validated
promotion_gates.description: A2ATaskLifecycleEvent model validates against rig.relay.a2a.task_lifecycle_event.v1 schema.

promotion_gates.title: DelegationReceipt schema validated
promotion_gates.description: A2ADelegationReceipt model validates against rig.relay.a2a.delegation_receipt.v1 schema with verdict enum of allowed/refused/completed.

promotion_gates.title: State machine transitions validated
promotion_gates.description: A2A task state machine enforces valid transitions (7 statuses, 9 valid transitions, 3 terminal states). Invalid transitions raise ValueError.

promotion_gates.title: Content-light guarantee verified
promotion_gates.description: All A2A models enforce content_light=true. No raw file content, secrets, or private data in any field. SHA-256 hashing for all content-derived values.

promotion_gates.title: Local-only enforcement
promotion_gates.description: remote_federation_supported=false enforced at model level. No network listeners for external A2A. Agent card defaults to local_only=true.

promotion_gates.title: Event-sourced lifecycle via CoordinationStore
promotion_gates.description: A2A task lifecycle events persisted through CoordinationStore with content-light event records. Events include task creation, state transitions, and delegation receipts.
promotion_gates.description_gap: Lifecycle events defined but persistence through CoordinationStore not yet wired. Events are in-memory only.
promotion_gates.required_resolution: Wire A2ATaskLifecycle to CoordinationStore for event persistence. Each transition must produce a schema-valid lifecycle event written to the events ledger.

promotion_gates.title: Capability-gated delegation
promotion_gates.description: A2A task delegation must pass capability gate checks. Delegation receipts include capability decision verdict. Mutation delegations refused by default.
promotion_gates.description_gap: RigClient.evaluate_capability() gates mutation but A2A-specific delegation capability checks not yet wired to the delegation path.
promotion_gates.required_resolution: Add A2A-specific capability evaluation to delegation path. Delegation must check that delegating and receiving agents both have the required capabilities.

promotion_gates.title: External A2A disabled until all gates pass
promotion_gates.description: External A2A federation must remain disabled (external_enabled=false) until all 10 promotion gates are passing. No network transport for A2A exists in v0.

required_next_actions: Wire A2ATaskLifecycle to CoordinationStore for event persistence (g8)
Add A2A-specific capability evaluation to delegation path (g9)
Both items are post-alpha — current blocked gates are acceptable for internal dogfood substrate v0
telemetry_redaction_notes: A2A event-sourced records must be content-light: no raw task content, agent prompts, or file content in coordination events. SHA-256 only for content-derived values.
